AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  APRIL 7, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE
PROVISIONS OF THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND TELECONFERENCED. TO PARTICIPATE IN A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN
EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (562) 929-5720 BEFORE 5 P.M. ON MEETING DAY
TO REQUEST A CALL DURING THE MEETING FOR A SPECIFIC ITEM OR ORAL COMMUNICATIONS.
DETAILS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT: https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-
agendas-393.

  6:00 PM
  NORWALK CITY HALL/COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Rios

INVOCATION
  Mayor Rios

FLAG SALUTE
  Grissel Chavez
  Director of Public Safety

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of March
  17 and 19, 2020. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period February 23, 2020 –
  March 7, 2020, in the total amount of $934,544.60. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  March 11, 2020 – March 31, 2020, in the total amount of $4,233,04.93. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIM AGAINST THE CITY - Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Becky Santos.
  830-19

  Report

  5.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-19 - BUDGET AMENDMENT- PURCHASE OF MOTORCYCLE UNITS - Staff
  recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-19, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF
  THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20
  ADOPTED BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE FUNDS FOR THE PURCHASE OF TWO LAW
  ENFORCEMENT MOTORCYCLES, in the amount of $90,000.

  Report

REPORTS

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-21 – AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE AGREEMENTS
  WITH THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TAX AND FEE ADMINISTRATION FOR
  IMPLEMENTATION OF A LOCAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE TAX - RESOLUTION NO. 20-22 -
  AUTHORIZING THE EXAMINATION OF TRANSACTIONS (SALES) AND USE TAX RECORDS - CITY
  COUNCIL APPROVAL OF RELATED AGREEMENTS AND AUTHORIZING TRANSMITTAL OF SAME
  TO THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-21, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE AGREEMENTS WITH THE
  CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TAX AND FEE ADMINISTRATION FOR IMPLEMENTATION OF
  A LOCAL TRANSACTIONS AND USE TAX;
   b.  adopt Resolution No. 20-22, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING THE EXAMINATION OF TRANSACTIONS (SALES) AND USE TAX
  RECORDS;

  c.  approve the various agreements and authorize the City Manager to execute all agreements and
  any amendments provided there is funding in the budget and documents required on behalf of the
  City, in a form approved by the City Attorney; and

  d.  approve the agreement for Transactions Tax Audit & Information Services between the City and
  HdL and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments provided
  there is funding in the budget on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

  7.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-20 - CERTIFICATION OF THE MARCH 3, 2020 ELECTION - Staff recommends
  City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-20, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK RECITING THE FACT OF THE GENERAL/SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD ON
  MARCH 3, 2020, DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY
  LAW.

  Report

SPECIAL ITEMS

  I.  OUTGOING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

  II.  COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

  III.  OATH OF OFFICE FOR NEWLY ELECTED COUNCILMEMBERS
  Rick Ramirez
  Margarita L. Rios
  Ana Valencia

  IV.  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION – Staff recommends City Council turn the meeting over to the City
  Clerk to initiate the process for the selection of a Mayor and Vice Mayor. 825-08

  Report

  V.  INCOMING MAYOR’S COMMENTS

  VI. INCOMING COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS

APPOINTMENTS

  8.  ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Councilmembers either re-appoint current Advisory
  Body members or make new appointments for two-year terms beginning April 1, 2020 through March
  31, 2022. 200

  Report

  9.  NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY APPOINTMENTS - Staff seeks City Council direction for the two
  four-year terms currently filled by Mr. Shryock and Mr. Vernola.

  Report

  10. PLANNING COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS - Staff recommends Councilmembers Ramirez, Rios, and
  Valencia appoint members of the community to serve as Planning Commissioners.

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT
 I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated April 2, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
